title: 11 The Hospital Hallway · 医院走廊里的孩子

sents.t: Chucho Gutierrez is a nurse who works at a hospital in Veracruz, a city in Mexico.
sents.zh: Chucho Gutierrez 是一名护士，在墨西哥韦拉克鲁斯市的一家医院工作。

sents.t: It's three in the morning, and Chucho is filming his colleagues, who are currently on break.
sents.zh: 凌晨三点，Chucho 正在拍正在休息的同事们。

sents.t: But as he records them, something disturbing is seen in the background.
sents.zh: 可就在他拍的时候，背景里出现了让人不安的东西。

sents.t: A child is seen walking down the hall, but there's something off about this child.
sents.zh: 一个孩子正沿着走廊走过去，但这个孩子有点不对劲。

sents.t: Moments later, it reappears, but this time, crawling on all fours.
sents.zh: 过了一会儿它又出现了，但这次是四肢着地爬行。

sents.t: Perhaps this might have been a patient of the hospital who passed away.
sents.zh: 这也许是医院里一位去世的病人。

sents.t: A spiritual cleanse might help with getting rid of those who've died but whose presence still lingers.
sents.zh: 做一次“灵性净化”，也许能帮忙送走那些已经去世、却还在徘徊的存在。
